basis: The unchanged v4 prompt at medium left one false material-error rejection and two exact unit-status misses. Prior high tests used older prompts, so one high-only v4 development test is informative without opening fresh heldout cases.
development_rule: Run each exposed development case once at high reasoning. Every unchanged gate must pass. Do not rerun medium or low and do not retry a usable unfavorable judgment.
heldout_rule: Only a full development pass permits a committed high-effort freeze followed by exactly two isolated passes over the still-fresh QN cases.
hard_stop: If high fails any development or fresh-heldout gate, stop prompt/configuration search for this submission, retain the failure, and narrow or replace the semantic endpoint prospectively rather than continuing evaluator tuning.
